Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt

Record Class MqttMessageProperties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt.MqttMessageProperties
public record MqttMessageProperties(List<MqttMessageProperties.UserProperty> userProperties, Long messageExpiryInterval, String contentType, byte[] correlationData, String responseTopic) extends Record
The MQTT 5.0 message properties this client models as first-class fields, decoupled from the Eclipse Paho types so both publish and received paths can carry them and they can be unit-tested without a broker. Every field is optional; an unset field is null (or, for user properties, the empty list).

Covered properties (MQTT 5.0 §3.3.2.3, the PUBLISH properties):

  • User properties — an ordered list of arbitrary UTF-8 name/value pairs; duplicate names are permitted and order is preserved.
  • Message Expiry Interval — lifetime in seconds the server retains the message for still-to-connect subscribers; null means no expiry was set.
  • Content Type — a UTF-8 MIME-style description of the payload (e.g. application/json).
  • Correlation Data — opaque bytes a request/response requester uses to match a response to its request.
  • Response Topic — the topic a responder should publish the response to.

Instances are immutable: the user-property list and correlation-data array are defensively copied on construction and on access, and equals(Object)/hashCode() compare the correlation bytes by value.
